name: On the Graffiti Road
description: During this time, you've visited many places in Natlan to gather inspiration at Dopey Dazzler's suggestion, and you've learned a lot. It's time to report back to her...

steps.description: Report your recent progress to Dopey Dazzler

dialogs.content: Heya! You're back!
Judging by your looks, I assume you've seen some spots, gathered some materials, and found your inspiration?
Well... sorta? We certainly had fun along the way!
Having a specific goal in mind helped us notice lots of details we wouldn't have before...
This material-gathering project's been a real eye-opener for us, and we've come away with lots of samples too!
Just a shame that we might not be able to use them all in our graffiti.
Oh, take your time, no rush! The whole point of the tour around Natlan was to help you realize what "avant-garde" is in the first place.
Speaking of which, mind telling me what you've seen and heard?
You show Dopey Dazzler the graffiti guidebook and the various photos you've taken...
Hmm... Well. Aren't you the conscious photo-taker?
I didn't expect you to be so experienced with Kameras as to subconsciously select excellent compositions for all these pictures.
If anything, there's a danger I'll be stunting your growth if I say too much. Just a little guidance is all you'll need.
Please, take these notes of mine. Just give them a quick flick through when you encounter scenery on your journey. Perhaps they'll help you take pictures of even greater artistry!
Huh. And here Paimon thought we'd be treated to a picture-by-picture analysis and... Y'know, avant-garde introductory lectures!
Paimon's also tempted to try doing some graffiti herself...
All the more reason to think that you're talented enough for self-driven learning!
If anything, too much by-the-books learning might snuff that sort of potential out.
As such, I think I need to adjust my role from responsible mentor to an assisting senior artist.
Just wait for a rush of inspiration at the opportune moment, then pick your paint jar up and show the world what you've got!
Huh. We're that talented, are we?
Hehe... Looks like all the commissions we took from painters and film directors haven't gone to waste!
My thanks for the compliments, then.
Relax! You'll get the hang of avant-garde aesthetics on your own in no time!
I'm usually over in the Masters of the Night-Wind's lands, prepping for the construction of the Graffiti Alliance's headquarters. If you have any questions, feel free to head over and ask me.
I'll be sure to kit you out with a fine set of graffiti-making implements next time you pop by!
Nice! So that's where your headquarters are going to be... We'll remember that. Best of luck!
This was a pretty great time!
Let's not forget to flick through Dopey Dazzler's notes when we're free. Can't do our artistic instincts any harm, huh?
Who knows, we might make a fortune from showing off our skills as graffiti grandmasters someday!
See you again!
We'll do our best to figure this out.
My avant-garde philosophy still needs some refinement.
